22-05-2023 Heard Mr. A. A. Dewan, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. M. P. Goswami,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam for the State.
By this application under Section 439 CrPC the petitioner, namely, Sahabuddin Page No.# 2/3 Hussain is seeking bail in Bijni P.S. Case No.51/2023 registered under Sections 420/489(C)/34 IPC corresponding to G.R. No. 100/2023, wherein, he was arrested on 05.04.2023 and since then, he is Sahabuddin Hussain vs The State Of Assam on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172965328/
1 in custody.

entities.text: Sahabuddin Hussain vs The State Of Assam
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Matter relates to involvement of distribution of fake currency.
As per the forwarding report dated 05.04.2023, the petitioner was to handover the said money to the other arrested accused Lalrinsanga, who was also arrested along with the petitioner on 05.04.2023.
Later, a coordinate Bench of this Court released the said accused vide order dated 04.05.2023, passed in BA No.1563/2023.
Perused the case diary placed before the Court today by Mr. Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam.

Considering the above and the period of detention of the petitioner in custody since 05.04.2023, the Court is of the view that further custodial detention of the petitioner is not warranted to investigate the said Bijni P.S. Case No. 51/2023.

As such, this bail application of the petitioner in said Bijni P.S.
Case is accepted.

Accordingly, the petitioner, namely, Sahabuddin Hussain, be released on bail in said Bijni P.S. Case No. 51/2023, on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.35,000/-, with 2 (two) local sureties of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Bijni on conditions that the petitioner shall - (i) appear before the Investigating Officer of said Bijni P.S. Case No.
51/2023 as and when he is required for necessary investigation of the case; (ii) not leave the territorial jurisdiction of the Bijni Police Station, without obtaining prior written permission from the concerned Investigating Officer of the case; (iii) not hamper with the investigation, or tamper with the evidence of the case and (iv) he shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement,
threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer, failing which, the bail granted to him in the aforesaid Bijni P.S. Case No. 51/2023 shall stand automatically vacated.
Page No.# 3/3 Return the case diary herewith.
Bail application accordingly stands allowed to the extent above.
